system.description:
You store your chakra within your blade before you open your mouth, releasing a small cloud of venomous gas, that you spin and swing your blade through, releasing your stored chakra tearing through the ground and area creating a claw like rift shredding through everything with sharpened venom.

All creatures in a 30-foot cone originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapon Damage] + 2d10 poison damage and inflicting 2 ranks of Envenomed on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

Serpent Coil. If you use a Strike ability from the Serpent’s Coil stance or as a Venom Art, as part of this jutsu’s casting, creatures that fail their saving throw, are also inflicted with Virulent until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d10.
